rulesQuote: Requirements & Guidelines for Residential Consumers • Limit: Maximum of 1 cubic meter (1 cu. m.) or one fetch per day per account to minimize congestion. • Active Accounts: Present an updated Statement of Account (SOA), water bill, or official receipt to personnel on-site. • Inactive Accounts: Visit the BCWD Commercial Office on Gov. J.A. Rosales Avenue for reactivation prior to fetching. […] • Boil Water Advisory: Boil all fetched or stored water before using it for drinking or cooking.

stations.name: Pump Station No. 1 – Alviola Village
stations.sourceQuote: Fetching Stations & Operating Hours • Pump Station No. 1, Alviola Village: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Residential Consumers)

locNote.ceb: Pin: BCWD compound sa Km. 5, Alviola Village, kung asa sab ang BCWD property office ug supply warehouse. Amihanan nga kilid sa highway, mga 300 m sa kasadpan sa Bombo Radyo. Kumpirmaha ang eksaktong gate.
locNote.en: Pin: the BCWD compound at Km. 5, Alviola Village, which also holds the BCWD property office and supply warehouse. North side of the highway, about 300 m west of Bombo Radyo. Confirm the exact gate.

stations.name: Barangay Buhangin Station
stations.sourceQuote: Fetching Stations & Operating Hours • Barangay Buhangin Station: 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Residential Consumers)

locNote.ceb: Pin: Buhangin Barangay Hall, Purok 4, duol sa Magsaysay Bridge. Wala ihatag sa BCWD ang eksaktong lugar; ang barangay hall ang pinakaposible nga fetching point. Pangutan-a ang barangay.
locNote.en: Pin: Buhangin Barangay Hall, Purok 4, near Magsaysay Bridge. BCWD gives no address for this station; the barangay hall is the most likely fetching point. Ask the barangay to confirm.

stations.name: Pump Station No. 17 – beside the BCWD Filtration Plant
stations.sourceQuote: BULK WATER SALES • Process: Pay at the BCWD Main Office, then present the Official Receipt at Pump Station No. 17 (beside the BCWD Filtration Plant, Brgy. Taguibo).

locNote.ceb: Pin: sentro sa Brgy. Taguibo. Ang filtration plant naa sa may Taguibo River.
locNote.en: Pin: centre of Brgy. Taguibo. The filtration plant is along the Taguibo River.

note.ceb: Bulk water sales: bayad una sa BCWD Main Office, dayon ipakita ang Official Receipt dinhi
note.en: Bulk water sales: pay at the BCWD Main Office first, then present the Official Receipt here
